# dokku_app_docker_image (Data Source)

Reads the image currently backing an app's running containers (`dokku ps:inspect`). Requires the app to have at least one running container.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) App to inspect.

### Optional

- `null_if_not_deployed` (Boolean) If true, set `image`, `image_id`, and `id` to null instead of failing when the app doesn't exist or has no running containers.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String) Image reference the app's running container was created from (`docker inspect`'s `Config.Image`), e.g. "dokku/my-app:latest".
- `image_id` (String) Content-addressed ID of the image backing the app's running container (`docker inspect`'s `Image` field), e.g. "sha256:...".
